ABOUT ME

You should only have to delegate it once.

I'm Emmanuella Oseni, an enthusiastic, proactive Executive Assistant and Operations Partner who is driven by results. I work quickly, take initiative and bring structure to the responsibilities that would otherwise keep a founder tied to the day-to-day details of their business.

See moreSee less

When you delegate work to me, my responsibility is to carry it forward independently. I clarify what's expected, coordinate the right people, manage deadlines, prepare briefs and drafts, and follow up until the work is complete. I keep you informed without making you the default person everyone depends on for an update. I work within agreed decision-making authority and bring you only the matters that genuinely need your input.

My goal is to help reduce the time you spend on routine operational management toward one hour a day, reserved for decisions, approvals and reviewing important drafts. That's a pilot target to be agreed and measured against your current workload, not a promised result.

I bring more than administrative support. I can map business processes, build practical trackers and workspaces, document SOPs, prototype solutions and use simple automation where it makes sense. My background in a hospital molecular laboratory has shaped my attention to detail, discretion and reliable handoffs. I use AI to accelerate research, drafting and summarization while maintaining human review, accuracy and confidentiality.

I want my contribution to be visible in the way a team works: clearer priorities, fewer avoidable follow-ups and more time for leadership to focus on growth. Based in Lagos, Nigeria (UTC+1), I am open to supporting founders and distributed teams internationally.
